verdict: Maybe. uBreathe from Gurgaon pitched a smart natural air purifier that uses plants on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Air pollution is severe in North India, and buyers want purifiers, but plant-based claims must be backed by test data.
angle: Air purifiers sell strongly in North India in winter. Natural or plant-based purifiers stand out, but buyers compare performance numbers. Independent tests build trust.
